items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Connie Berry as a friend of 'Babe's' and states 'They worked together', but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not claim a personal relationship with Connie Berry in the provided text.

ctx.x: Savannah, Georgia. And I just left a good friend of ours, terrific pianist, by the name of Connie Berry, a good friend of Babe's. They worked together.
